title: Ownership changed on a path built from input (c)
description: The code changes file ownership with chown and a path assembled at runtime. Resolution happens at call time, so a symlink or a renamed parent redirects the change onto a file the caller did not intend. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer checks the path source.
remediation: Operate on an already-open descriptor, or resolve and validate the path first, for example fchown on an already-open descriptor.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the call without resolving the path at runtime.
